title: Deliver Oil to Conhill City Oil Refinery
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Oil** delivered to **Conhill City Oil Refinery** (industry id 4, near tile 3,132).

A likely supplier is **Fort Runtburg Oil Wells** (industry id 8, near tile 21,156); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **610 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
